annotations.title: OpenAPI spec summary: operations, auth and servers

description: Read an OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2 document (JSON or YAML, up to 2 MB) from a URL and summarise it for an agent: title, version, description, servers, auth schemes, operation count by method, tags, which operations are paid (402 or x-payment-info) or deprecated, and up to 150 operations with method, path, summary and operationId. Use before calling an unfamiliar API, to pick an endpoint, or to compare APIs. Example: url=https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/openapi.json. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
